scope: Source/GDI reference audit only; no native/Crystal screenshot comparison or acceptance
coordinateConvention: All windowRelativeControlOrigin coordinates must be added to actual GuildDialog.DisplayLocation. Screen-global origin is not known from source because Center/drag depends on runtime screen; do not claim absolute screenshot pixels.

originalDrawRules.labelFont: Settings.FontName default Arial; Settings.cs72 default and255 INI override
originalDrawRules.scaleFont: font.Size * 96f / MirControl.FontDpiX; getter uses CMain.Graphics.DpiX, fallback96
originalDrawRules.autoSize: MirLabel false unless explicitly true; true uses TextRenderer.MeasureText and adds2 to each size if outline
originalDrawRules.defaultTextFlags: WordBreak; GDI default glyph padding retained; no NoPadding; Headers override Right; experience label overrides VerticalCenter|HorizontalCenter
originalDrawRules.textBox: WinForms TextBox.BorderStyle.None, AutoSize default true; DrawToBitmap, not TextRenderer label. Actual10pt96DPI TextBox height16 while Mir wrapper requested21. Notice explicit8pt multiline, separate from recruit10pt single line.
originalDrawRules.sprite: MirImageControl.UseOffSet default false and MLibrary.Draw offSet=false; manifest x/y are not automatically added. Image Size default AutoSize uses alpha GetTrueSize dimensions but draw still uses full bitmap at control origin; no automatic alpha-bound origin subtraction.

limitations: Actual Settings.ini FontName, font rasterizer version, Graphics.DpiX and Crystal window screen origin were not measured; reference explicitly Arial/96DPI.
Original library source raw Lib files not re-decoded here; exported PNG hashes verified against pinned manifest; alpha true bounds derived from those exact PNGs.
No claim of current native screenshot pixel equality; no gameplay or service launched.
